{"sourceType":"ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/ESATenderActions/filter/open","id":187340,"idEra":25127,"activityNumber":"1000046506","contractNumber":"","tanumber":"1-13538","title":"M2 PCIE NVME SOLID STATE DRIVES FOR FUTURE MASS STORAGE SOLUTIONS EXPRO+","description":"Objective: To develop a memory array based on M2 PCIe NAND flash memory Solid State Drives modules and characterise the radiation effects and possible mitigation methods at software and hardware levels.Description: High density Mass storage solutions based on NAND flash memory Solid State Drives (SSD) are widely used in data server applications and present a great opportunity for space applications. However, their reliability and their tolerance to radiation-induced effects have not been evaluated so far. M2 PCI ExpressNon-Volatile Memory (NVM) storage drives are now commonly used System on Module (SoM) devices, similar in size to Double Dada Rate (DDR) memory modules used in personal computers, and capable of storing over 1TB of data. These SoMs incorporate advanced Error Detection and Correction (EDAC) systems to manage the frequent occurrence of bad blocks and bits in 3D NAND Flash Memories. Het betreft enerzijds een Tinn-silver 450 en anderzijds een Tinn-silver 390. Beide zijn uitgerust met een moonpool van 29 op 29 cm. Er dient 1 surveypaal geleverd te worden die op beide vletten kan worden ingezet.
